about: The Black Marsh soundtrack: one original piece per role of a classic open-world RPG score (theme, 8 exploration, 7 battle, 3 stings). docs/design/music.md. Each prompt = the shared style + the piece's axes. Audio is generated, never committed; each piece names one reference track (reference) and the feel it is written to (feel); prompts carry only `style` + `axes`, never a reference; the manifest keeps every take.
style: Original instrumental game soundtrack for a tropical swamp jungle province of reptilian people. Shared palette: breathy cane reed flutes, plucked wooden tongue-drum and thumb-piano tones, hollow log drums, bone and wooden clackers, conch shell horns, low bowed strings and a deep sustained drone, wordless low throat-singing and humming choir (no words, no lyrics). Recurring signature motif: a four-note call that rises a perfect fourth, then falls a half step and a whole step and holds. Production: warm, spacious, humid reverb like a canopy at night, analog warmth, no modern synths, no electric guitar, no drum kit, no lyrics, cinematic and organic.

pieces.axes: Main title theme. Majestic and ancient, slow build from solo reed flute stating the four-note call over the drone to full low strings, log drums and wordless choir carrying the call in broad unison. 70 BPM, D minor (dorian colour). Lead: reed flute then massed low strings. Awe at a living, breathing marsh.
pieces.feel: Moderate, stately 3/4-feeling pulse around 70 BPM; minor mode with a modal, ancient colour. One lone line states a simple, singable tune, then each restatement adds instruments and grows in volume and scope until violins and full brass carry a climactic finish. Light, gentle, ethereal rather than heavy; long crescendo shape, quiet start, loud end.

pieces.axes: Exploration at dawn over still black water, about 3 minutes, 60 BPM, A minor, free and unhurried pulse. [0:00-0:50] Scattered held tones on drone, low strings and breathy reed flute enter one by one, overlapping like a sunrise slowly gathering, very quiet. [0:50-1:50] A calm, spacious middle: soft plucked thumb-piano over the drone, the four-note call once, softly. [1:50-3:00] The texture churns and builds: busy repeating low string figures and short conch-horn interjections, then eases away. Mood: hushed, then awakening.
pieces.feel: Slow, about 60 BPM, free-feeling pulse. Opens like an orchestra tuning: scattered, overlapping held tones that gather into increasingly complex orchestration, like a sun rising; settles into a calm, spacious middle; closes over busy string ostinati with short brass-like interjections. Dark, quiet start, building, churning end. Minor/modal.

pieces.axes: Exploration under a green rainforest canopy, about 3 minutes, 84 BPM, E dorian, gentle steady walking pulse. [0:00-0:30] A dark, low opening: held deep bowed bass chords and drone, quiet. [0:30-2:40] It opens into a brighter, airy walking theme: breathy cane flute melody over light plucked strings and thumb-piano, soft wooden seed rattles, the four-note call answered by the flute; small swells, never loud. [2:40-3:00] Thins back to flute and drone. Mood: curious, warm.
pieces.feel: Walking pace, about 84 BPM, gentle steady pulse in 4. A dark, low introduction on sustained double-bass chords opens into a much brighter, ambient field theme; woodwind melody over light pizzicato strings; warm, unhurried, mid-level dynamics with small swells.

pieces.axes: Exploration along a slow, wide river, about 3 minutes, 76 BPM, G mixolydian, flowing pulse with a lightly syncopated, lilting melody. Solo cello sings long phrases over rich layered low strings and rippling plucked-wood figures; the four-note call in the cello. Shape: long gentle crescendos and decrescendos, two broad arcs, the second fuller with soft log drum. Mood: journeying, hopeful.
pieces.feel: Moderate flowing tempo, about 76 BPM in 4 with a syncopated lilt in the melody; major/mixolydian, hopeful. Rich, layered string textures with a solo cello carrying the tune; gradual crescendos and decrescendos in long arcs; journeying, warm.

pieces.axes: Exploration near an ancient sacred tree, reverent and mysterious, layered humming choir chords, low drone, sparse bone chimes, the call sung softly. 56 BPM, C minor. Lead: wordless humming choir. Mood: sacred, dreamlike.
pieces.feel: Slow, about 56 BPM, austere and solemn. A jagged, unflowing solo cello leads over sparse accompaniment; harmony balanced between light and dark, major and minor, high and low, held in tension. Quiet to moderate, reverent, with an undercurrent of unease.

pieces.axes: Exploration on a warm sea coast, about 3 minutes, 72 BPM, F major, gently rocking 6/8 pulse like small waves. Light breathy reed flute leads a reflective tune over soft bowed strings and drone; soft conch horn answers with the four-note call. [0:00-1:00] flute and strings, light. [1:00-2:10] a broad, warm swell with log drum and choir hum. [2:10-3:00] back to flute alone, fading. Mood: open, reflective, calm.
pieces.feel: Slow to moderate, about 72 BPM, gently rocking pulse; major key with modal touches. Light flute texture over soft strings, reflective and warm; a broad pastoral swell in the middle, then a quiet close. Open, nostalgic, calm.

pieces.axes: Exploration on dry mesa highlands above the swamp, about 3 minutes, 96 BPM, B dorian, light and playful. [0:00-1:10] Light plucked string and thumb-piano ostinati in a three-against-four cross-rhythm, a bowed folk fiddle with the four-note call. [1:10-1:50] A wordless humming choir interlude, airy. [1:50-2:40] Ostinati return. [2:40-3:00] Dissolves into reed flutes alone. Mood: lively, wide, wandering.
pieces.feel: Moderate, about 96 BPM, light and playful; a 3-against-4 cross-rhythm in light-hearted string ostinati; a choir interlude in the middle; dissolves into a simple woodwinds-only section; moves smoothly between moods; mid dynamics.

pieces.axes: Exploration at tropical night, about 3 minutes, 54 BPM with almost no felt pulse, F sharp minor, unresolved. Low held tones on bass reed flute, deep drone and distant low throat-singing; soft wooden rattles like insects; the four-note call on low flute, very quietly, twice. Quiet throughout, one slow swell in the middle and back. Mood: dark, warm, ominous.
pieces.feel: Slow, no clear pulse; brief, ominous underscore: low held tones, dark colour, quiet throughout with a slight swell; minor and unresolved.

pieces.axes: Exploration in warm rain over a bayou, about 3 minutes, 66 BPM, D dorian, restful. [0:00-1:10] Thumb-piano and breathy flute trade phrases over soft strings and pattering wooden percussion; the call passed between them. [1:10-2:10] An ethereal, airy wordless high choir floats in, gentle swell. [2:10-3:00] Glistening high string tremolo and a lone flute fading out. Mood: tender, melancholy, at rest.
pieces.feel: Slow, about 66 BPM, restful and tender; strings and woodwinds in gentle dialogue, a middle section with an ethereal wordless female choir, ending on glistening high string tremolo and a fading flute; soft dynamics with one gentle swell.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes 30, 140 BPM, D minor, starts at once at full intensity. [0:00-1:00] Driving fast low-string ostinato with syncopated stabbing accents, pounding log drums and bone clackers, conch horns shout the four-note call. [1:00-1:35] A calmer, tense middle: drone, quiet drum pulse. [1:35-2:30] The driving section returns, loud, ends on a hit. Mood: sudden danger.
pieces.feel: Fast, about 140 BPM; driving violin ostinato with syncopated accents; ABA form with a calmer middle section; sudden start at full intensity, loud, tense.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes 15, 132 BPM, E minor, relentless. Driving low-string ostinato and hand drums never let up; conch horns in bright stacked open fourths and fifths ring above; rhythmic wordless throat grunts; the four-note call in the horns. Loud throughout with a final surge. Mood: predatory chase.
pieces.feel: Fast, about 132 BPM; relentless forward pulse; stacked open fourths and fifths in high brass over driving strings; bright, hard, loud throughout.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes, 126 BPM, C sharp minor, energetic and continuous. Fast flowing bowed string runs over heavy giant drums and a menacing drone; dark low horn swells from conch; the four-note call low and broad. Loud, constant motion, a heavier final section. Mood: monstrous, heavy, relentless.
pieces.feel: Fast, about 126 BPM; energetic, flowing fast violin lines over strong percussion; continuous motion; loud, heroic and dark.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes, 150 BPM, A minor, quick and nimble. Rapid falling string ostinato figures with syncopated counter-rhythms in wooden percussion; booming resonant log drums; one shrill reed flute and one fiddle as soloists; the four-note call fast on the flute. Loud, frantic. Mood: skirmish.
pieces.feel: Fast, about 150 BPM; rapid descending violin ostinato figures with syncopated counter-rhythms; booming resonant drums against one or two solo instruments; the main theme's material returns; loud, nimble.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes, 120 BPM, G minor, martial. Minimalist repeating war-drum patterns on deep resonant log drums carry it, forceful and insistent; a massed wordless chanting choir and few other instruments above; the four-note call as a rallying cry. Loud from start to end, building in weight. Mood: defiant.
pieces.feel: Moderate-fast, about 120 BPM; stripped-back, minimalist repeating drum rhythms needing a resonant, forceful sound; few instruments above the drums; martial, insistent, loud.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes, 128 BPM, B minor, brooding. Sparse, repetitive churning rhythm on hollow gourds and wood like splashing water, swirling string figures rising and falling, low reeds with the four-note call; surges of intensity like a storm. Mood: chaotic, drowning.
pieces.feel: Moderate-fast, about 128 BPM; sparse, repetitive rhythmic writing; dark, brooding, churning; loud with surges.

pieces.axes: Battle music, about 2 minutes, 136 BPM, F minor, desperate. The first seconds announce the fight with a bold full-ensemble hit; driving drums and full low strings; the choir swells; tension builds to a climax with the four-note call at full force. Loud. Mood: desperate last stand.
pieces.feel: Fast, about 136 BPM; a battle theme whose opening seconds announce a fight; bold brass and strings over drums; driving, heroic, builds tension to a climax; loud.

pieces.axes: A level-up fanfare sting, the whole piece is 8 seconds. [0:00-0:03] starts instantly with no intro: a fast low rolling swell of hollow log drums and low strings rising in a single crescendo. [0:03] one broad, bright, triumphant arrival in D major: full ensemble and a powerful wordless choir with conch shell horns stating the four-note call once. [0:04-0:08] the final major chord rings out and decays. [0:08 onward] silence.
pieces.feel: Skyrim's own level-up tracks (mus_levelup_01-03, measured): 18.7-19.3 s; a steady body for about 12 s, a climb to the peak at 12.0-12.9 s, then down 20 dB within 2.0-2.3 s of the peak and under -40 dB by 16.8-18.6 s. Ours: an excerpt of the same shape cut from the Overture.

excerpt.why: A: the Overture's closing statement from a downbeat (119.6 s) into its final chord (133.4 s, 13.8 s in), which rings out on its own decay under a 3.5 s fade; 19.0 s

excerpt_alternatives.why: B: the first full-ensemble statement from a downbeat (25.7 s), its loudest bar at 40.0 s (14.3 s in), faded over the phrase tail before the next phrase at 45.3 s; 19.5 s
C: from the quiet point before the arrival at 34.8 s, through the 40 s peak and the next phrase's peak at 50.0 s (16.4 s in), faded over the held chord 50.7-52.2 s; 18.6 s

pieces.axes: A short mournful sting about twelve seconds long: the four-note call slowed on low reed flute over a fading drone and a single low drum, then silence. D minor.
pieces.feel: A short jingle, about 17 seconds: a falling, mournful gesture, minor, low, ending in silence.

pieces.axes: A short wondering sting, 15 seconds long. [0:00-0:10] Shimmering thumb-piano and an airy wordless humming choir rise into the four-note call, one soft drum, A major, luminous. [0:10-0:15] the choir chord held and fading to silence.
pieces.feel: Slow; angelic choir and a solo high voice bring a starry-eyed sense of wonder; soft, rising, luminous.
